questions.question: Should the supporting set also cover the three required companion-field selections needed to submit the follow-up workflow after selecting Design, rather than only the category selection?

summary: Inspected the chart and existing chains: all six visible category-adjacent percentage inscriptions are covered for the labeled-value ranking, and the conflicting dot-height versus printed-label reading is already represented conditionally. The remaining coverage limit is completion of the required workflow fields after the category choice.
